brief: Edit the selected first kitten into a gentle moonlight celestial cultivation appearance. Keep precisely the same feline face, expression, proportions, body pose and signature scarf. A refined mythic spirit-cat candidate, still adorable and elegant.

changes.coat_color: Preserve cream-white fur with only a subtle warm pearl and pale gold rim sheen, no full-body recoloring.
changes.coat_pattern: Tiny understated gold-lavender cloud wisps along the tail tip only.
changes.aura: A slim floating pearly crescent arc behind the upper body, with a little soft stardust; it does not intersect the head or cover the ears, no giant halo.
changes.accessories: Keep the pink scarf and original four-point gold star. Add a tiny jade-and-pearl charm beside the clasp, proportionate to a kitten; no armor, crowns or human clothing.

target.placement: pet appearance preview, no baked text
